candidateSourceStatus: Frozen before heldout opened; root approved exact engine/planner pair.
scope: Precommitted36 paired complete games per version plus12 mixed-policy reversal games. Counts chosen on development cost before any heldout results.
mixedPolicy: Planner controls seats with (seat+mixedOffset)%2===1; released policy controls other seats. Same seed/rotation/first for reversal.
balance: Each starting seat appears6 times overall and once per seed. Each starting profile appears6 times overall. Within each seed only3 starting profiles are represented twice each; profile parity is associated with alternating seed groups. Not a full factorial and cannot separate seed-by-starting-profile interactions.
mainMeasures: completed goals, first timing, holding, directed supplied frontier and independent adjacency route deficit
actual multi-action execution within commitments, observed supplied targets/frontier changes/air use/goal results; label-only completion is not success
airport activation through same-airport air use before loss, supplied drops, direct later air-turret hits, observed enemy supply changes
spatial combat and occupation divided by area; late activity; seed/seat/profile/score disparities
decision mean/p50/p95/p99/max; node/depth/private-memory bounds; hidden-data invariance and seeded replay
controls: Development tactical puzzles run with same response policy against baseline; at least one real opponent cut and imminent goal finishing attempt. Fixed-board public-seed variation and memory-reset are mechanism probes, not heldout balance evidence. Mixed-policy games are a limited adversarial probe, not population win-rate proof.
resources: At most3 compute workers. Root full Node tests and actual600s browser may share4CPUhost; record contention and avoid device performance claims.
rules: No tuning on heldout. Do not reduce counts or discard unfavorable outcomes after results. Any frozen runtime change invalidates affected source comparison and must be labeled as a new candidate.
